findings.text: no arm covers the current-attempt comparison at reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py:363, so replacing `_exit_record_names_attempt(record, attempt)` with `return True` leaves every added assertion green while a superseded attempt's exit record would again be read as this attempt's end.

the discriminator matches prose that reckon/crew/recovery_wait.py:502 and :511 own, so rewording either reader's detail silently disables the halted arm with nothing reddening; a structured field on the observation would not couple the two modules.
